text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.333 for the Junior Software Engineer position. Key gaps include a missing must-have requirement for git, as well as several missing nice-to-have skills such as web development frameworks, nosql, html, css, and pytest. The application was escalated for review because the candidate is overqualified for the role, despite falling below the scoring threshold and missing a required skill.
